name: How long does wood siding replacement typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does wood siding replacement typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a wood siding replacement project depends on the size of your home, the complexity of the existing structure, and weather conditions. For an average-sized home, the process can take anywhere from one to three weeks. This includes preparation, old siding removal, new siding installation, and finishing touches like painting or staining. Our team prioritizes efficient work while maintaining high quality standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wood siding replacement typically takes 1 to 3 weeks for an average home, depending on size and complexity.
